environment:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ORIGINAL GAME ENVIRONMENT SPRITE ATLAS, not a scene.
Input image 1 is ONLY the style reference: our approved tiny chibi adventurer. Match its confident dark brown near-black outlines, big clean pixel clusters, restrained olive/brown/cream palette and minimal shading. Do not redraw or include the character.
Primary request: Create eight separated top-down 3/4 RPG woodland props on a genuinely transparent background, arranged in exactly FOUR EQUAL COLUMNS and TWO EQUAL ROWS with generous transparent gutters. Every sprite is centered within its own equal cell. No touching cells, no partial or clipped sprites.
Row 1 left to right: (1) mature broadleaf oak, rounded irregular olive canopy with visible stout brown trunk and no detached roots, (2) a different mature broadleaf oak with slightly asymmetric crown, (3) a tall compact evergreen, (4) another evergreen with a slightly broader base.
Row 2 left to right: (1) a low rounded dark olive bush, (2) an irregular olive bush with 3 muted cream flower dots, (3) a solid low pile of three mossy gray-brown rocks, (4) a small fern tuft.
Style: actual hard-edged low-resolution pixel art with coherent single-pixel staircase edges, simple cluster shading, one dark outline, 3/4 overhead viewpoint. Mature trees should feel about three times taller than the reference character when prepared for gameplay; branches and leaves belong to one complete connected tree silhouette. Effective native pixel dimensions approx trees 80-96 wide by 112-128 tall, bushes 32-40 by 24-32, rocks 32 by 24, fern 16 by 20, presented enlarged by a uniform nearest-neighbor scale.
Palette: use the character's #252323 outline, #574236 warm bark/shadow, #68734b olive foliage, #e6cf9a cream accents; optionally #3d4b36 deep foliage, #899364 light foliage, #817565 stone, #b7a381 stone light. Darker muted foliage than the previous bright Ninja Adventure environment. Broad simple clusters, subdued highlights.
Avoid: characters, lettering, labels, grids, shadows on a background, glows, gradients, soft painting, detailed leaf speckle, photoreal texture, ground tiles or scenery. Keep the entire sheet transparent.
